value.answer: Depends if you mean soccer or American football. Soccer: I'd go Messi. He has 8 Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's 5, and the recent World Cup run has pushed a lot of people his way. Ronaldo has a strong case on goals and Champions League titles, and some still name Pelé. NFL: I'd still go Tom Brady with his 7 Super Bowl wins. Mahomes is the one coming up fast, but he hasn't caught Brady yet.
